name: Egyházashetye (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, yellow at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egyházashetye: a blue shield with a white tower and a red charge, within a yellow wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
